correctness.rationale: Relies explicitly on verified prior complete four-class equifacial-octahedron classification, not inventing it anew. Coordinate axes have squared half-lengths (a²+b²−c²)/2 and permutations. For twisted six-vertex construction p²=r²+d², q²=r²+e², s²=2r²+(e−d)², one has Vtw=(2/3)r²(d+e), coordinate squared half-lengths de, r²+e(e−d), r²+d(d−e). Algebraic subtraction is the exact nonnegative perfect square with factor 4/9. Scalene excludes d=e; equality r²=2de forces s strictly largest and parameter e/d=t>1 yields stated acute family. All 8 congruent facet areas imply unique inball at symmetry center by sum of face normals zero, with V=8Δrho/3, hence identical inradius ordering. Explicit witness d=1,e=2,r²=4 gives sides (sqrt5,2sqrt2,3), both volumes 8 and radii 1.
